title: elymus trachycaulus subsp. virescens
intro: Elymus trachycaulus subsp. virescens, commonly known as Wild Wheat Grass, is a type of grass that belongs to the family Poaceae. This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, which include reducing inflammation, improving digestion, and boosting the immune system. The therapeutic actions of Wild Wheat Grass are attributed to its antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties, which may help to soothe digestive issues and promote overall well-being. The bioactive constituents of Elymus trachycaulus subsp. virescens include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
